## 🧪 Universal Zero-Red-Line Quality Gate

- [ ] **Compiler / Typecheck**: 0 red lines confirmed (`npx tsc --noEmit`, `mypy .`, `go vet ./...`, `cargo check --all-targets`, `phpstan analyse`).
- [ ] **Linter / Formatter**: 0 warnings or syntax errors (`npm run lint`, `ruff check .`, `flake8 .`, `cargo clippy`, `php -l`).
- [ ] **Test Suites**: Unit and integration test suites pass completely (`npm test`, `pytest`, `go test`, `cargo test`, `composer test`).
- [ ] **Secrets Audit**: Verified no `.env` keys, tokens, or untracked private credentials in diff.
